The instrument features a circular brass casing with a hinged glass cover that is currently open to the right. The dial face is off-white or cream-colored with intricate black markings, including numerical scales and weather condition text (e.g., 'STORMY', 'RAIN', 'CHANGE', 'FAIR'). A central pointer hand indicates the current pressure reading. The barometer sits on a dark wooden base or surface against a teal or greenish background.
